Get early access to free workflows, guides, and exclusive content only on my Patreon Page!

Use this workflow to create stunning video animations by transforming your subject (dancer) and giving them a dynamic aura that expands and contracts in time to the beat. You can use this workflow with a single subject or multiple subjects as seen in the examples above.

You will need to install my latest AKatz Custom Nodes pack using ComfyUI Manager for this workflow to work. (You should be able to install via 'Install Missing Custom Nodes' menu after loading the workflow).
